propositions: Guard G3 in inbound removal path cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones due to missing evidence store for peer confirmations
Record key (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with fields link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source must be persisted in .bridge_state/peer_confirmations.json
Outbound link confirmations must be recorded at the set_relationship success point in _update_one_dispatch_links via optional link_confirm callback, after _links_applied counter increments
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip confirmation recording entirely rather than persist vendor keys in local-id fields
Store must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to survive snapshot compaction and prevent silent drops of confirmation-only changes
Callback exceptions must be logged and swallowed to ensure confirmation write failures never perturb successful outbound links or computed/applied/failed counts
